parts.name: 2 Hole - Leveling Anchoring Base Plate
parts.description: 2 hole base plate that mounts to a profile end and provides an offset hole so a leveling foot and floor anchor can be used at the same time. An extension pin helps align the plate within the T-slot to keep the profile from rotating.
features: Mounts to profile end; provides offset hole that allows leveling foot and floor anchor to be used at the same time
Extension pin helps align base plate within T-slot to keep profile from rotating
